$comment: Ceilings for `bun harness/bench/cli.ts check`, by benchmark id (`bench list`) and metric. A gated metric with no entry here has a budget of 0. Raising one is how an intended growth is accepted: do it in the PR that needs it, add the reason to $why, and say it in the PR description. Sizes are brotli KB, set at about 1% over what staging shipped on 2026-10-23.

$why.size.initialJsKB: 330 -> 333 on 2026-10-23 (fix/list-scrollbar): the drawn page scrollbar (doc-scroll.tsx, until now only in the lazy watch and admin chunks) loads with Home, whose box now uses it; first-load JS measured 330.4 KB brotli, about 1% headroom over it. Before: 327 -> 330 on 2026-10-23 (feat/hover-menus): useHoverMenu (hover intent, close grace, the aim triangle, one open menu at a time) loads with the top bar's four menus; first-load JS measured 327.2 KB brotli, about 1% headroom over it.
$why.size.allJsKB: 400 -> 401 on 2026-10-23 (fix/admin-shape-error): the admin lists and recommendations turn an unreadable answer into Page Out of Date with Reload instead of printing the zod issues; measured 400.0 with staging already at the ceiling. Before: 396 -> 400 on 2026-10-23 (feat/admin-tabs): the admin page's tabs, Songs filter and the pre-0013 Worker field compatibility, all in the lazy /admin chunk (first-load JS went down: the admin-only hooks left lib/admin); about 1% over the measured 396.6. Before: 391 -> 396 on 2026-10-23 (feat/queue-playlists): the playlist panel, the shuffle and the play-context model add about 0.8 KB brotli across all chunks; about 1% over the measured 391.8.
$why.size.cssKB: 20.3 -> 20.4 on 2026-10-24 (fix/sticky-title-variant): the bar-hidden rule of sticky-under-topbar moved inside the utility, so Tailwind emits it for the not-pointer-fine: variant the Gallery title uses as well as the bare class; measured 20.3 with staging already at the ceiling. Before: 20.1 -> 20.3 on 2026-10-23 (feat/queue-playlists): the playlist panel over Up Next and the Button toggle variant (Shuffle's pressed state) add about 0.1 KB brotli; about 1% over the measured 20.2. Before: 19.7 -> 20.1 on 2026-10-23 (fix/generation-panel): the notifications panel's close-into-the-button keyframes, the top bar staying in while the panel shows, and the finished rows' hover/focus dismiss X and Play touch target add about 0.2 KB brotli of first-load CSS. About 1% over the measured 19.9.
